== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Hunger is a powerful and terrifying force characterized by an overwhelming desire to devour everything. It exists as an aura, a [[madra]], and a network that has woven itself throughout a [[labyrinth]], developing its own unique identity tied to the maze. While some believe [[hunger madra]] is merely a corrupted form of [[pure madra]] that escaped into the wild, it is an immense power capable of consuming minds, thoughts, and even entire portals. The essence of hunger is driven by an insatiable need to consume that has persisted since its inception, often manifesting as a parasitic sensation or an extreme urge to gain strength. This force can be experienced as an echo, an icon, or a [[binding]], and it possesses the capacity to overwhelm individuals with a compulsion to consume [[natural treasures]], food, or even other living beings.}}
